2607.25959.title: Detecting Knowledge Inconsistencies Across Text, Tables, and Knowledge Graphs
2607.25959.paper_summary: Wikipedia and Wikidata are widely used for information access, LLM pre-training, and retrieval-augmented generation. Their knowledge is deeply connected but scattered across text, tables, and knowledge graphs. This raises a practical question: when these modalities disagree, how can we detect and explain the conflict? We study this problem as \emph{modality-level inconsistency detection}. We first introduce a taxonomy of cross-modal knowledge inconsistencies, covering information granularity differences, direct conflicts, temporal changes, and KG incompleteness. We then present \textsc{Kontrast}, an automatic framework that uses Text-to-SPARQL and LLM reasoning to compare table-based answers with KG evidence and categorize the resulting inconsistencies. Experiments on various Table-QA datasets show that cross-modal inconsistencies are common and informative. They reveal not only true knowledge conflicts, but also missing KG structure and temporal mismatches while being limited by Text-to-SPARQL errors and noise. Our analysis shows that text, tables, and KGs can complement and correct one another through systematic comparison. \textsc{Kontrast} provides a practical tool for large-scale knowledge auditing and establishes a benchmark for future work on cross-modal knowledge consistency. Code and data are available at https://github.com/ECLADATTA/KONTRAST.
2607.25959.paper_summary_zh: 維基百科和維基數據被廣泛用於信息獲取、LLM 預訓練和檢索增強生成。它們的知識深度相連，但分散在文本、表格和知識圖譜中。這引發了一個實際問題：當這些模態不一致時，我們如何檢測和解釋衝突？我們將這個問題研究為 \emph{模態級不一致性檢測}。我們首先介紹了一個跨模態知識不一致性的分類法，涵蓋信息粒度差異、直接衝突、時間變化和知識圖譜不完整性。然後，我們提出了 \textsc{Kontrast}，這是一個自動框架，利用 Text-to-SPARQL 和 LLM 推理來比較基於表格的答案與知識圖譜證據，並對產生的不一致性進行分類。對各種 Table-QA 數據集的實驗表明，跨模態不一致性是常見且具有信息價值的。它們不僅揭示了真正的知識衝突，還顯示了缺失的知識圖譜結構和時間不匹配，同時受到 Text-to-SPARQL 錯誤和噪聲的限制。我們的分析顯示，文本、表格和知識圖譜可以通過系統比較相互補充和修正。 \textsc{Kontrast} 提供了一個實用的工具，用於大規模知識審計，並為未來的跨模態知識一致性研究建立了一個基準。代碼和數據可在 https://github.com/ECLADATTA/KONTRAST 獲得。
